# Introduction

An Obsidian deposit is a resource node and is found in the Mountains biome and require an Iron pickaxe or better to harvest.

## Availability

Obsidian deposits appear as small, sphere-shaped rocks with distinct black colored veins, which help differentiate them from regular rocks at a distance. They yield Obsidian when mined.
They are only found on the surface.

## Drops

• Item: Drop Rate | Obsidian: 5-8

## Notes

• Obsidian deposits do not respawn.
• Unlike other resources that require mining, Obsidian can be teleported.
